info.title: Zot API
info.description:
#### Overview
Zot API provides a comprehensive solution for managing waitlists and user authentication

#### Rate Limiting
API requests are subject to rate limiting. Please handle 429 responses appropriately.

access_token.description: JWT access token for authenticated requests

name.description: Name to identify the API key
Name to identify the API key

clientName.description: Optional human-readable name of the CLI client requesting access.

deviceCode.description: Opaque device code the CLI uses to poll.

userCode.description: Short human code used as fallback when manual entry is needed.

verificationUri.description: Base URL the CLI should open in the user's browser.

verificationUriComplete.description: Full URL (with session token) the CLI should open. Opens the authorize page directly without manual code entry.

userCode.description: User code. Required when the user typed it in manually instead of following the session URL.

apiKeyName.description: Name to assign to the generated API key.

status.description: Session status. 'approved' means apiKey is present. 'authorization_pending' and 'slow_down' mean keep polling.

apiKey.description: The issued API key, only returned once on the first 'approved' poll.

interval.description: Interval hint for the next poll, in seconds.

code.description: React component code to be compiled to HTML

variables.description: Variables (props) to inject into the component at render time.

html.description: Compiled HTML output from React component
html.example: Hello World!

couponCode.description: Optional promotion code to apply immediately. If omitted, Stripe Checkout still allows entering a code manually.

sessionId.description: Checkout session id generated by Stripe

url.description: Stripe-hosted URL where the user completes the subscription purchase

received.description: Indicates that webhook event was accepted

url.description: Webhook URL to notify when a new user signs up

range.description: Notify webhook every N users registered

webhook.description: Webhook configuration for new signup notifications
